security.title: Security
security.twofaOn: On. You will be asked for a code from your authenticator app when you sign in.
security.twofaOff: Off. Add a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy…) to protect your account.
security.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
security.manual: Can’t scan? Enter this key manually:
security.recoveryBody: Each code works once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
security.disableBody: Enter a current code from your authenticator app to turn off two-step verification.
security.signOutAllBody: Ends every session, including this one. You will need to sign in again.
